#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

long long solve(long long a, long long b) {
    if (a == 1) {
        long long c = b % 6;
        if (c == 4)
            return (b / 6) * 6 + 2;
        else if (c == 5)
            return (b / 6) * 6 + 4;
        else
            return (b / 6) * 6;
    } else if (a == 2) {
        if (b <= 2)
            return 0;
        else if (b == 3 || b == 7)
            return a * b - 2;
        else
            return b * 2;
    } else {
        long long ans = a * b;
        if (ans % 2 == 0)
            return ans;
        else
            return ans - 1;
    }
}

int main() {
    long long a, b;
    cin >> a >> b;
    if (a > b) swap(a, b);
    cout << solve(a, b) << endl;
    return 0;
}
